# hyperpowers state

This branch holds the SDD dossiers of this repository (progress ledgers, implementer reports, claims), one directory per plan under plans/. hyperpowers maintains it through skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/sdd-state.
It shares no history with the code and is never merged into a code branch.
Design: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-10-20-portable-sdd-dossiers-design.md in the hyperpowers repository.
